name: roledock
description: RoleDock: a framework for persistent agent roles, document-based knowledge, session handoff, and isolated collaboration across harnesses.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.desktop:probe: npm run desktop:build && npm run desktop:runtime && node packages/desktop/scripts/probe.mjs
scripts.desktop:e2e: npm run desktop:build && npm run desktop:runtime && npx playwright test --config packages/desktop/playwright.config.ts
scripts.desktop:package: npm run desktop:build && npm run desktop:runtime && cd packages/desktop && npx electron-builder --publish never
scripts.desktop:shell: npm run desktop:build:shell && npm run desktop:runtime && node packages/desktop/scripts/shell.mjs
scripts.desktop:e2e:shell: npm run desktop:build:shell && npm run desktop:runtime && npx playwright test --config packages/desktop/playwright.shell.config.ts
scripts.desktop:package:shell: npm run desktop:build:shell && npm run desktop:runtime && cd packages/desktop && npx electron-builder --config electron-builder.shell.yml --publish never
